description.value: (Social/utility - 2 BP, Tier 5.) You gain an edge on tests to interact with, read, or command lesser undead, ghosts, and the recently dead. For Sabbat this is thematic dynamite: his sprites are the recently-dead of the machine world, so Deathspeaker reinforces the fiction that his congregation comes willingly - a mechanical edge on the social/command side of dealing with the ghost-things he summons.
